intro: をはじめ comes from 始める, "to begin": you begin a list with its most prominent member and let the rest follow. It holds up X as the representative of a group, "X and others", "led by X". It belongs to formal writing, news and speeches.

skills.rule: A をはじめ(として) B: with A as the leading example, B, a group that includes A and more of the same kind.
skills.explain:
をはじめ (also をはじめとして, and before a noun をはじめとする) follows a noun. A is the best-known or highest-ranking member of a set, and the rest of the sentence names the set or more members: 東京をはじめ、大阪や京都にも店がある. In thanks and announcements it lists people by rank: 社長をはじめ、社員一同.

Two conditions must hold. The other members must be of the same kind as A, and there must actually be others: をはじめ cannot stand with A alone. It lists; it does not contrast or add something different.

Its neighbours do other jobs. を中心に names the centre or main focus of an activity: 若者を中心に人気がある (popular mainly with young people). に加えて adds something of a different kind: 雨に加えて風も強い. をもとに names a basis or source: 事実をもとに書いた小説.
patterns: [leading member] をはじめ、[others / the group] [predicate]
[leading member] をはじめとする [group noun]

examples.jp: 東京[とうきょう]{をはじめ}、大阪[おおさか]や京都[きょうと]にも店[みせ]があります。
examples.en: We have shops in Tokyo and also in Osaka, Kyoto and elsewhere.

examples.jp: 寿司[すし]{をはじめ}、日本[にほん]の料理[りょうり]は海外[かいがい]でも人気[にんき]です。
examples.en: Japanese food, sushi above all, is popular abroad too.

examples.jp: 校長[こうちょう]先生[せんせい]{をはじめ}、多[おお]くの先生[せんせい]が出席[しゅっせき]しました。
examples.en: Many teachers, led by the principal, attended.

examples.jp: 社長[しゃちょう]{をはじめとして}、社員[しゃいん]全員[ぜんいん]が会議[かいぎ]に参加[さんか]した。
examples.en: Every employee, starting with the president, took part in the meeting.

examples.jp: 富士山[ふじさん]{をはじめとする}日本[にほん]の山[やま]は、外国人[がいこくじん]にも人気[にんき]がある。
examples.en: Japan's mountains, Mount Fuji first among them, are popular with foreigners too.

contrast.note: を中心に says where the weight of an activity lies: 若者を中心に人気がある. をはじめ only names the first item of a list; it says nothing about focus.
はもちろん contrasts an obvious case with an extension and is fine in casual speech and requests. をはじめ lists same-kind members in a formal register.
に加えて adds something new, often of a different kind: 雨に加えて風も強い. をはじめ needs A to stand for a group of the same kind.

mistakes.bad: この歌[うた]は若者[わかもの]{をはじめ}人気[にんき]がある。
mistakes.good: この歌[うた]は若者[わかもの]{をちゅうしんに}人気[にんき]がある。
mistakes.note: "Popular mainly with young people" names a focus, not the head of a list: を中心に.

mistakes.bad: 雨[あめ]{をはじめ}、風[かぜ]も強[つよ]くなった。
mistakes.good: 雨[あめ]{にくわえて}、風[かぜ]も強[つよ]くなった。
mistakes.note: Rain does not lead a group that wind belongs to; simply adding is に加えて.

skills.tip: If "X, among others" or "led by X" fits the English, it is をはじめ.
